answer: The crate maker brands every crate with the year and his mark, so a broken crate can be traced to his bench. Crate hazel willow peeler hamper bond covers the branding: a bond hazel willow peelers lodge after peeling shed checks. The jade is the first brand struck, the atlas the last before the iron cools, and the trellis is the cooling, the iron hissing in the bucket. Faking the brand takes 41 false strikes and 41 false coolings.
